title: 4A Roll Sticky Notes with Dispensers, 6 Neon Colors, 6 Rolls, 0.6 x 393 Inches per Roll, Full Adhesive Paper for Planners and Labels
bullets: 6 rolls with individual dispensers: Includes six neon-color paper rolls, each 0.6 inch wide and 393 inches long, with a separate plastic dispenser for each roll.
Cut the length you need: Pull out the required length of paper and separate it using the dispenser's front serrated edge. Keep the roll seated in its dispenser during use.
Writable full-adhesive paper: Use the colored paper strips for short notes, indexing and labels, with adhesive across the back of the strip.
Color-code everyday plans: Coral, lime, orange, yellow, pink and blue help distinguish tasks, subjects and sections in planners, calendars and notebooks.

For paper marking and reminders: Apply to a clean, dry surface and test delicate finishes or printed pages first. Includes rolls and dispensers only; notebooks and pens shown in scenes are not included.
description: Make notes and paper labels in the length you need with 4A PSS 32x6 roll sticky notes. The set contains six neon-color paper rolls, each 0.6 inch wide and 393 inches long, with an individual dispenser. Pull out a short or long strip and use the front serrated edge to separate it. The writable, full-adhesive paper is useful for planner entries, indexing, color coding and everyday reminders. Test delicate surfaces and printed pages before applying. Notebooks and pens are not included.
